<thoughtml>
  <task>Select one research proposal for funding under a single-award budget constraint.</task>
  <options>
    <option id="ambitious">
      <title>Technically Ambitious Proposal</title>
      <strengths>
        <item>Strong preliminary evidence supports the core scientific premise.</item>
        <item>Potential for high-impact advances if successful.</item>
        <item>Addresses a more novel and consequential research question.</item>
      </strengths>
      <risks>
        <item>Technical approach has substantial execution uncertainty.</item>
        <item>Milestones are less concrete and harder to evaluate early.</item>
        <item>Delivery capacity is less proven than the competing team.</item>
      </risks>
    </option>
    <option id="safe">
      <title>Safer Delivery-Focused Proposal</title>
      <strengths>
        <item>Clear, measurable milestones enable reliable monitoring.</item>
        <item>Experienced team has a strong record of completing comparable work.</item>
        <item>Lower probability of delay, cost overrun, or non-delivery.</item>
      </strengths>
      <risks>
        <item>Expected scientific advance is more incremental.</item>
        <item>May create fewer transformative outcomes.</item>
        <item>Less preliminary evidence of a breakthrough opportunity.</item>
      </risks>
    </option>
  </options>
  <evidence>
    <evidenceItem supports="ambitious">Preliminary results are strong and directly relevant to the proposed hypothesis.</evidenceItem>
    <evidenceItem supports="ambitious">The proposal could produce unusually high scientific value if its technical risks are overcome.</evidenceItem>
    <evidenceItem supports="safe">The workplan contains explicit milestones, decision gates, and deliverables.</evidenceItem>
    <evidenceItem supports="safe">The delivery team has greater relevant implementation experience.</evidenceItem>
  </evidence>
  <panelPositions>
    <position member="Innovation-focused panelists" favors="ambitious">
      Strong evidence justifies accepting higher technical risk for a potentially transformative result.
    </position>
    <position member="Delivery-focused panelists" favors="safe">
      With only one award available, dependable execution and accountable milestones should receive priority.
    </position>
    <position member="Risk-balanced panelists" favors="ambitious">
      Fund the ambitious proposal only if the award can include staged milestones, independent review, and a credible contingency plan.
    </position>
  </panelPositions>
  <decision>
    <selection option="ambitious">Select the technically ambitious proposal.</selection>
    <rationale>
      Its strong preliminary evidence raises the probability that its high-impact potential is attainable, making the expected research value greater than that of the safer but more incremental alternative.
    </rationale>
    <conditions>
      <item>Require revised, measurable early-stage milestones.</item>
      <item>Release later funding only after independent review of technical progress.</item>
      <item>Require a contingency plan for key technical failure points.</item>
    </conditions>
  </decision>
</thoughtml>
